items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. Any player could be lying to you.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Tell the truth: you are solving a puzzle.
Ask players to explain their votes and powers.
Slow the table down.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Liberal team, the majority at the table. You win when the Liberal board is full or when Hitler is executed. With the Communists in the game, a Hitler execution is a win for them too.

details.label: What you know
text: Nothing. You get no information at setup and keep your eyes closed through the whole night. Every other player could be lying to you, and everything you learn comes from votes, claims, enacted policies and powers.

details.label: Power
text: You have no power of your own. When you are President you use the board powers like anyone else, and Investigate Loyalty, Policy Peek and Execution are your best tools to find the Fascists and Hitler.

details.label: Danger
text: With the Communists in the game, your Liberal membership card makes you a target for Radicalisation. If the Communists swap it for a Communist card, you become a Communist and win only if the Communists win. Check your card after every Radicalisation. A player whose card was already looked at by a Fascist-board power cannot be radicalised.

details.label: How to play it
text: Tell the truth: you are solving a puzzle, and a lie only confuses your own team. Ask players to explain their votes and powers, slow the table down when someone rushes a vote, and remember that when a Fascist policy appears, only the President, the Chancellor or the deck can be to blame.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Fascists and Hitler.
The Monarchist, who shows you a thumb.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: You cannot be radicalised.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Claim to be a Liberal.
Spend your trust to make Hitler look trustworthy.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Fascist team. You win when the Fascist board is full or when Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy. With the Spies in the game, your team also wins at once if one of you executes the Liberal Spy.

details.label: What you know
text: You open your eyes with the other Fascists at setup, and Hitler shows you a thumb, so you know your whole team. With the Monarchist in the game, the Monarchist shows you a thumb too, but plays for their own goal, not for you.

details.label: Power
text: You have no power of your own. When you are President, the Fascist-board powers are yours to use for the team: investigate a player and lie about the result, or execute the Liberal who sees through you.

details.label: Cannot be radicalised
text: Your membership card says Fascist, so a Radicalisation that picks you fails and you stay a Fascist.

details.label: Danger
text: Your membership card is the proof against you. Any Investigate Loyalty or Bugging that looks at you shows Fascist, and a Confession shows it to the whole table.

details.label: How to play it
text: Claim to be a Liberal. Spend your own trust to make Hitler look trustworthy, because electing Hitler as Chancellor is how the Fascists win most often. Create confusion and push for quick votes.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
You are elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Only the Fascist, when there is just one.
Otherwise nobody: show your thumb at setup.

sections.label: YOU MUST
items: Say that you are Hitler when executed, or when elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: A Bodyguard dies in your place, once.
You cannot be radicalised.

details.label: Goal
text: You lead the Fascist team. You win when the Fascist board is full or when you are elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

details.label: What you know
text: Usually nobody. At setup you keep your eyes closed and show a thumb, so the Fascists learn who you are, but you do not learn who they are. Only when there is exactly one Fascist do the two of you open your eyes together.

details.label: You must tell the truth
text: If you are executed, or if you are elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies, you must say that you are Hitler. These are the only moments in the game when a player may not lie.

details.label: Danger
text: If you are executed, the game ends and the Liberals win, with the Communists and the Monarchist. A Bodyguard who is still alive dies in your place, once, but then everyone knows who you are. After the 3rd Fascist policy, every newly elected Chancellor is asked whether they are Hitler, so each election you survive clears your name a little.

details.label: Cannot be radicalised
text: Your membership card says Fascist, so Radicalisation never turns you.

details.label: How to play it
text: Be as Liberal as possible: enact Liberal policies, vote for Liberal governments and let the other Fascists take the risks. You need the trust of the table at the moment it counts, when you are nominated Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Communist board is full.
Hitler is executed (the Liberals win too).

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Communists, from the start.
The Anarchist, who shows you a thumb.

sections.label: YOUR POWERS
items: Radicalisation and Congress: open your eyes with the Communists.
Capitalist hunt: before you execute a player as President, you may reveal your membership card. If you then execute the Capitalist, the Communists get an extra Radicalisation.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Communists, a third hidden party with its own board. You win when the Communist board is full or when Hitler is executed, which is a win for the Liberals too.

details.label: What you know
text: The other Communists: you open your eyes together at setup. With the Anarchist in the game, the Anarchist shows you a thumb, or opens their eyes with you when there is just one other Communist. Players you radicalise later learn who you are only at Congress.

details.label: Power
text: Communist policies give powers to the Communists, whoever the government is. At Radicalisation you open your eyes together and look at one player's face-down membership card. A Liberal card is swapped for a Communist card, and that player joins you. A Fascist card stays, and the attempt fails. At Congress you open your eyes again, so the new Communists learn who the original ones are.

Capitalist hunt: when you are President and about to execute a player, you may first reveal your membership card. If the player you then execute is the Capitalist, the Communists get an extra Radicalisation.

details.label: Danger
text: Both other parties play against you. Revealing your card for the Capitalist hunt shows the whole table your party, and any investigation of your membership card shows Communist.

details.label: How to play it
text: Claim to be a Liberal, and let Liberals and Fascists suspect each other. Radicalise the players the table trusts most, and remember that a failed Radicalisation tells you that card was Fascist.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Communist board is full.
Hitler is executed (the Liberals win too).

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. At setup, show your thumb to the Communists.
With just one other Communist, open your eyes with them.
Keep your eyes closed at Radicalisation and Congress.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Assassination, once per game: after a policy is enacted and before the next election, reveal your Secret Role card and execute a player.

rulebook.title: The Anarchist
rulebook.addWhen: your group knows the Communists well and wants a wild card.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Your group knows the Communists well and wants a wild card.
rulebook.pitch: A hidden Communist with one assassination: after any policy, anyone can be shot.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Communists. You win when the Communist board is full or when Hitler is executed, which is a win for the Liberals too.

details.label: What you know
text: Usually nobody. At setup you keep your eyes closed and show the Communists a thumb, so they know you, but you do not know them. Only when there is just one other Communist do you open your eyes with them. You keep your eyes closed at Radicalisation and Congress as well.

details.label: Power
text: Assassination, once per game. After a policy is enacted and before the next election, you may reveal your Secret Role card and execute any player. It counts as an execution in every way: shooting Hitler ends the game in a win for the Communists and Liberals, and shooting the Jester hands the Jester the win.

details.label: Danger
text: Once you reveal, everyone knows you are on the Communist side, and the Liberals and Fascists will see you as a target. The Communists cannot confirm you openly without giving themselves away.

details.label: How to play it
text: Wait until you are sure. The best shot removes a player the Communists cannot otherwise get rid of, or ends the game by finding Hitler.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU LOSE IF
items: Hitler is elected Chancellor.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. Show the Fascists your thumb.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: At Call Special Election, once the President names a pick, you may reveal and become President instead.
You and the outgoing President each name a Chancellor candidate.
Everyone hands a ballot card to their choice. Most cards wins, you break ties.

rulebook.title: The Monarchist
rulebook.pitch: A Fascist who wants the board, not Hitler. Splits the Fascist team and can seize the presidency at Special Election.

details.label: Goal
text: You are far right, but you play for your own goal. You win when the Fascist board is full or when Hitler is executed. You lose if Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy: the Fascists win then, but you do not.

details.label: What you know
text: Nobody. At setup you keep your eyes closed and show a thumb, so the Fascists (not Hitler) know who you are. You do not learn who the Fascists or Hitler are.

details.label: Power
text: There is only ever one President. When a President uses Call Special Election and names the next presidential candidate, you may reveal your Secret Role card. You then become the next President instead of that player.

The Chancellor is chosen differently in that round. You and the outgoing President (the one who called the Special Election) each name a Chancellor candidate. Every player hands one ballot card to the candidate they back, and the candidate with the most cards becomes Chancellor. If there is a tie, you decide. Then the legislative session goes on as usual.
The round after, the President placard returns to the left of the President who called the Special Election, as after any Special Election.

details.label: Danger
text: You want Fascist policies but not Hitler in power, so you have to find Hitler without help: the Fascists know you, but they will not tell you who Hitler is. Every time a Chancellor is elected after the 3rd Fascist policy, you could lose.

details.label: How to play it
text: Push Fascist policies, but block any Chancellor you suspect of being Hitler, and steer executions towards him. Save your power for the government that matters most.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The Fascists and Hitler: you open your eyes with the Fascists.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: The first time Hitler would be executed, reveal your Secret Role card.
You die instead, and Hitler lives.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Once you have saved Hitler, everyone knows who he is.
Push for a full Fascist board.

rulebook.title: The Bodyguard
rulebook.addWhen: Hitler is found and executed too often.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Hitler is found and executed too often.
rulebook.pitch: Dies in Hitler's place the first time he is shot, so one lucky execution no longer wins the game.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Fascist team. You win when the Fascist board is full or when Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

details.label: What you know
text: The Fascists and Hitler: you open your eyes with the Fascists at setup and see Hitler's thumb.

details.label: Power
text: The first time Hitler would be executed, by any kind of execution, reveal your Secret Role card. You die instead, Hitler lives, and the game goes on. It works once, and only while you are alive.

details.label: Danger
text: Saving Hitler shows everyone who Hitler is, so he will never be elected Chancellor again. After that, the Fascists can win only by filling their board. If you are executed before Hitler is, the protection is gone.

details.label: How to play it
text: Stay alive and unsuspected, so the shield is still there when Hitler is found. Once you have saved him, push for a full Fascist board.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The Fascists and Hitler: you open your eyes with the Fascists.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Once per game, at any moment: reveal your Secret Role card and execute a player.
If that player is the Liberal Spy, the game ends right away and the Fascist team wins.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Be certain before you shoot.
A miss leaves the Liberal Spy free to talk.

rulebook.title: The Fascist Spy
rulebook.addWhen: you want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Liberal Spy.
rulebook.addWhenTable: You want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Liberal Spy.
rulebook.pitch: Can shoot once at any moment. Hitting the Liberal Spy wins the game for the Fascists.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Fascist team. You win when the Fascist board is full, when Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy, or when a player of your team executes the Liberal Spy.

details.label: What you know
text: The Fascists and Hitler: you open your eyes with the Fascists at setup. Like every Fascist, you show your thumb to the Liberal Spy, so the Liberal Spy knows you.

details.label: Power
text: Once per game, at any moment, you may reveal your Secret Role card and execute a player. If that player is the Liberal Spy, the game ends at once and the Fascist team wins. It counts as an execution in every way, so shooting the Jester hands the Jester the win.

details.label: Danger
text: A miss reveals you as a Fascist and leaves the Liberal Spy free to steer the table against your team.

details.label: How to play it
text: Watch who seems to know too much: the Liberal Spy knows the Fascists and will try to vote against them quietly. Be certain before you shoot.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Every Fascist except Hitler: at setup they show you their thumbs.

sections.label: DANGER
items: If a player of the Fascist team executes you, the game ends right away and the Fascists win.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Never say outright that you know the Fascists.
Steer the votes quietly.

rulebook.title: The Liberal Spy
rulebook.addWhen: you want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Fascist Spy.
rulebook.addWhenTable: You want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Fascist Spy.
rulebook.pitch: Knows every Fascist except Hitler, but must stay hidden: if the Fascists shoot them, they win.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Liberal team. You win when the Liberal board is full or when Hitler is executed.

details.label: What you know
text: Every Fascist except Hitler: at setup you open your eyes while the Fascists show their thumbs. The Monarchist does not show a thumb to you.

details.label: Danger
text: If any player of the Fascist team executes you, as President, with Confession or with the Fascist Spy's shot, the game ends at once and the Fascists win. The Fascists know that a Liberal Spy is in the game and will look for you.

details.label: Help quietly
text: Your knowledge is only worth something while nobody knows that you have it. Use it to steer votes and nominations, never to accuse openly.

details.label: How to play it
text: Never say outright that you know the Fascists. Vote against Fascist governments as if by instinct, and let other Liberals draw the conclusions.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Centrists: you open your eyes together at setup.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: If you are radicalised, you join the Communists. The other Centrists are not told and may still trust you.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Wait before you reveal that you are Centrists.
Fascists will pretend to be Centrists.
The Communists will want to radicalise you.

rulebook.title: Centrists
rulebook.addWhen: the game is big and the Liberals need a small group that trusts each other.
rulebook.addWhenTable: The game is big and the Liberals need a small group that trusts each other.
rulebook.pitch: Liberals who know each other from the start: a trusted core the others can build on.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Liberal team. You win when the Liberal board is full or when Hitler is executed.

details.label: What you know
text: The other Centrists: there are 2 to 4 of you, and you open your eyes together at setup. You know nothing about anyone else.

details.label: Radicalisation
text: You hold a Liberal membership card, so the Communists can radicalise you. A radicalised Centrist joins the Communists and wins only if the Communists win. The other Centrists are not told, so they may keep trusting a player who no longer plays for them.

details.label: Danger
text: Fascists and Communists will claim to be Centrists. A claim proves nothing to the rest of the table, and only the real Centrists know who is lying.

details.label: How to play it
text: Wait before you reveal that you are Centrists: a known group is easy to target. Use your trust to form governments, and check your card after every Radicalisation.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: TWO MEMBERSHIP CARDS
items: At Radicalisation, show the Fascist one. You are never converted.
At Investigate Loyalty, show the Liberal one.
At Bugging, show either one.

sections.label: LOBBY CARD
items: At Radicalisation, give it to the player you trust most. They may vote three times with it, once.

sections.label: DANGER
items: A revealed Communist President who executes you earns them a Radicalisation.

rulebook.title: The Capitalist
rulebook.addWhen: Communist policies pass too quickly or Radicalisation is too easy.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Communist policies pass too quickly or Radicalisation is too easy.
rulebook.pitch: A Liberal who can never be radicalised and hands out a Lobby card worth three votes.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Liberal team. You win when the Liberal board is full or when Hitler is executed.

details.label: What you know
text: Nobody. You open your eyes only during Radicalisation, after the Communists have closed theirs, to hand out the Lobby card.

details.label: Two membership cards
text: You hold a Fascist and a Liberal card. At Radicalisation you put out the Fascist one, so you can never be radicalised. At Investigate Loyalty you show the Liberal one. At Bugging you choose which one to show.

details.label: Lobby card
text: During each Radicalisation you open your eyes and place the Lobby card on the card of the player you trust most. That player may spend it once to vote three times in one election.

details.label: Danger
text: The Communists hunt you. A Communist President who reveals their membership card before an execution and then executes you earns the Communists an extra Radicalisation.

details.label: How to play it
text: Give the Lobby card to a player you are sure of, and keep your role hidden so the Communists cannot aim at you.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: You are executed. The game ends at once and only you win.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Look suspicious, but not too obviously.
Every execution counts: by a President, Confession, the Anarchist or the Fascist Spy.
Never claim to be the Jester.

rulebook.title: The Jester
rulebook.pitch: Wins alone if executed, so every execution becomes a gamble.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for nobody. You win if you are executed: the game ends at once and only you win. Every execution counts, by a President, by Confession, by the Anarchist or by the Fascist Spy.

details.label: What you know
text: Nobody. You keep your eyes closed through the whole night.

details.label: Your Fascist card
text: You hold a Fascist membership card, so any investigation shows Fascist and Radicalisation never turns you. That is your best tool for looking guilty.

details.label: Danger
text: If any team wins before someone executes you, you lose. A player who works out that you are the Jester will never shoot you.

details.label: How to play it
text: Look suspicious, but not too obviously. Never claim to be the Jester.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The party on your Party Membership card wins.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Once per game, reveal your Secret Role card and cast three votes in one election.
It stacks with the Lobby card.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Save your votes for the election that decides the game.
Revealing shows your role, never your party.

rulebook.title: The Propagandist
rulebook.pitch: Casts three votes once, enough to swing one election.

details.label: Goal
text: You belong to the party on your membership card, which the group chooses at setup, and you win when that party wins.

details.label: What you know
text: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup. As a Liberal you learn nothing.

details.label: Power
text: Once per game, you may reveal your Secret Role card and cast three votes in one election. If you also hold the Lobby card, you may use both in the same election.

details.label: Danger
text: Revealing shows your role but never your party. From then on the table knows a big vote is gone, and every side will try to work out which party you used it for.

details.label: How to play it
text: Save your votes for the election that decides the game, such as a Hitler Chancellor vote after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The party on your Party Membership card wins.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Once per game, reveal your Secret Role card and look at the top two policies of the discard pile.
Afterwards you can never be nominated Chancellor.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Look right after a government you doubt.
Revealing shows your role, never your party.

rulebook.title: The Bureaucrat
rulebook.addWhen: Liberals are too often fooled about which policies were discarded.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Liberals are too often fooled about which policies were discarded.
rulebook.pitch: Looks at the top two discarded policies once, to catch a lying President or Chancellor.

details.label: Goal
text: You belong to the party on your membership card, which the group chooses at setup, and you win when that party wins.

details.label: What you know
text: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup. As a Liberal you learn nothing.

details.label: Power
text: Once per game, you may reveal your Secret Role card and look at the top two policies of the discard pile. You may tell the table what you saw, or lie about it.

details.label: Danger
text: The price: once you have used the power, you can never be nominated Chancellor again. Revealing shows your role but never your party.

details.label: How to play it
text: Look right after a government you doubt, while its discards are still on top of the pile.

sections.label: SETUP
items: At night, draw a membership card from the spare deck. You join that party.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The party you drew wins.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: When Bugging or Investigate Loyalty comes up while you are President or Chancellor, you may reveal and take it over.
You alone choose the player and look.
They show you their Secret Role card, not their party.
No power at any other time.

rulebook.title: The Detective
rulebook.pitch: Joins a random party and turns Bugging or Investigate Loyalty into a look at the target's Secret Role card.

details.label: Setup
text: You start without a membership card. At the very start of the night you open your eyes alone and take the top card of the spare membership deck (2 Liberal, 1 Fascist and 1 Communist card). You now belong to that party: put the card in your envelope and wake with that party later in the night.

details.label: Goal
text: You win when the party you drew wins.

details.label: Power
text: Your power works only in two moments: when Bugging or Investigate Loyalty comes up while you are the sitting President or Chancellor. You may then reveal your Secret Role card and take that power over.

Taking it over means you alone use it. You choose the player, not the President, and not the President and Chancellor together. That player secretly hands you their Secret Role card instead of their membership card, and nobody else sees it. You may tell the truth about what you saw, or lie.
At any other time you have no power and play like any member of your party.

details.label: Danger
text: Revealing tells everyone you are the Detective, but not which party you drew. Whatever you announce, the side it hurts will call you a liar, and may try to execute you.

details.label: How to play it
text: Save your reveal for the investigation that matters most. A Secret Role card tells you far more than a party card: it can unmask Hitler or a hidden extra role.
